what: Posted speed limits our extract is missing, for speed_overrides.py (BackRoad Apps LLC, 2026-10-10). An active entry writes maxspeed="<n> mph" into OUR extract only, stamped slowgo:maxspeed_override=<id> and slowgo:maxspeed_source=<type>, never an OSM upload. Read speed_overrides.py and docs/memos/villages-unposted-speeds-2026-10.md before adding one.

rows.source: Sumter County Public Works sign inventory (public GIS: gisweb.sumtercountyfl.gov/sumtergis/rest/services/Operations/Sign_FieldEdits/FeatureServer, panels joined to supports by POLEID): three ACTIVE R2-1 'SPEED LIMIT 35' panels, poles 0004406 (28.90245,-81.95351, faces N), 0004410 (28.90945,-81.95358, faces N), 0004394 (28.91202,-81.95374, faces SE). The county roads layer's Speed_Limi=45 is a class default, not a posted value, and is not used.
rows.confidence: medium (official, but inventoried 2016; nothing newer found)
rows.why: Blocks 3 of the 76 measured trips together with Rolling Acres Road south; on its own it unblocks none.

rows.source: Sumter County Public Works sign inventory (public GIS: gisweb.sumtercountyfl.gov/sumtergis/rest/services/Operations/Sign_FieldEdits/FeatureServer, panels joined to supports by POLEID): two ACTIVE 'SPEED LIMIT 30' panels (pole 0004723 at 28.8475,-81.9993 faces NW, and one at the south end) and one ACTIVE 'SPEED LIMIT 20' panel. 30 is written; the 20 panel may be a short zone and needs a look before ruling.
rows.why: Withholds 1 of the 76 measured trips (Lake Okahumpka Recreation Center to Lake Okahumpka Park); 30 unblocks it.

rows.source: Sumter County Public Works sign inventory (public GIS: gisweb.sumtercountyfl.gov/sumtergis/rest/services/Operations/Sign_FieldEdits/FeatureServer, panels joined to supports by POLEID): two ACTIVE 'SPEED LIMIT 40' panels.
rows.why: Stays amber (40 is over 35). Writing it turns a guessed 36-45 into a posted 40, so the card can say the real number.

rows.source: FDOT Maximum_Speed_Limit_TDA, roadway 18580000 (MP 0-0.79 = 45, MP 0.79-4.031 = 55), the copy in scripts/fdot-audit/data/fdot_maxspeed.gpkg fetched 2026-07-16; matching Sumter County sign panels 45 (pole 0005242) and 55 (poles 0005219, 0005226), 2016-05-18. Sumter BOCC 2025-04-22 renamed C-470 east of US 301 to Central Parkway.
rows.confidence: high that it is above 35; 45 vs 55 split within the way is the only judgement
rows.why: Our map has it unposted (amber). FDOT says 45/55; the rename to Central Parkway likely kept the DOT enrichment from matching it (a pipeline gap to fix too). Writing 55 makes routes along it refused under every setting, which is true.

rows.source: FDOT Maximum Speed Limit (TDA) layer, the copy we already hold (data/fl_fdot_maxspeed.gpkg): ROADWAY 18570000 (CR 44A), mileposts 3.917-4.92, SPEED 35, Sumter County, covering this roundabout. The same record is already written to the neighbouring roundabout piece (way 1498361487: maxspeed 35 mph, maxspeed:source FDOT, slowgo:fdot_roadway 18570000). This piece was missed by conflation, probably because it is so short. Buena Vista Boulevard on both sides is posted 35.
rows.confidence: high (FDOT record covers the spot; the sibling piece of the same roundabout already carries it)
rows.why: The single trigger of the default-setting NoGo for Spanish Springs Town Square -> Brownwood Paddock Square (2026-10-12): a 26 ft unposted CR 44A piece is painted amber mid-route, so the 1.3 final-approach rule can't trim Kiessel Road. With this row the trip is served, ending about 300 ft short at Kiessel Road.
